title: NDC-2939 scoring rule save without row_version
rows: PUT /scoring-rules/{QA RT18 SR H2} points 5, row_version 1
400 SCORING_RULE_VERSION_REQUIRED "Send the scoring rule's rowVersion (the one you loaded) with the save, or If-Match" → stored points still 5, version 2
409 SCORING_RULE_VERSION_CONFLICT "changed by someone else … (current version 2)" → points still 5
